rootCause: The authored Vietnamese title has two ASCII spaces before Ban công. The HTML document.title getter collapses ASCII whitespace to one space. After a later head mutation, the observer compared that normalized getter with the raw title, wrote the raw title again, and generated another head mutation. Its unbounded microtask loop prevented the renderer from servicing input and pending tasks. Edge reproduced naturally; Chrome reproduced after one explicitly injected diagnostic head mutation, proving that the defect is application/content/locale dependent rather than exclusively Edge-specific.

temporaryTabOnlyPatch.method: While paused, installed a document.title setter guard that writes only when the native getter differs from the ASCII-whitespace-normalized value, then resumed.
temporaryTabOnlyPatch.reason: Later controlled InPrivate test: clean EN listing gallery responded; setter guard installation returned confirmation in Console; switching the same tab to VI preserved responsiveness and the VI gallery opened. This proves the mechanism in tab memory, not a deployed fix.
temporaryTabOnlyPatch.scope: Test tab memory only; no deployed application or CMS content was edited. Reload restores the original page implementation.

performanceLimit: Console reported a 128080ms message-handler violation after resuming, but the duration includes debugger pause time and must not be reported as a CPU benchmark. The debugger stack and the pending Console expression are the direct main-thread-blocking evidence.
